hidden_assets.purpose: Gold experimental F2‑symmetry mode frequencies for two impurities in InP
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 7 and text (Section III.b-1.2): 522.8 cm⁻¹ for B substituting In, 270 cm⁻¹ for As substituting P.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper’s reported experimental values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are experimentally measured frequencies reported in the paper and used as ground truth; they are not invented or fabricated.

outputs.description: Computed vibrational mode frequencies (F2 symmetry) for two impurity-host pairs. The computed frequency is the solution of the secular determinant; the checker compares it to the experimental reference within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the F2 symmetry modes are computed. The host Green's functions are constructed from the RIM 11 parameter set given in the paper. The agent must implement the Brillouin zone summation and secular equation root-finding. The experimental frequencies for B/In and As/P are not disclosed in this contract.
